title: Reggie Saunders Drops Infectious New Single “THEY DON’T KNOW”
htmlContent:
Los Angeles singer/songwriter Reggie Saunders is making waves with the release of his latest single, "THEY DON'T KNOW". Known for his heartfelt performances and soulful voice, Reggie draws inspiration from legendary artists such as Stevie Wonder.

"THEY DON'T KNOW" is a smooth R&B/soul track that showcases Reggie Saunders' extraordinary talent. Fans of Silk Sonic and Marvin Gaye will find themselves drawn to the captivating melodies and touching lyrics of this new release. The song serves as a tribute to that special person who stands by your side.

In his own words, Reggie Saunders shares, “This song, ‘THEY DON'T KNOW’, is a homage to that person who truly has your back and fulfils all of your needs.”

Reggie Saunders continues to electrify audiences with his outstanding vocal performances and undeniable musicality as heard on “THEY DON’T KNOW”. His unique blend of classic soul influences and contemporary R&B makes him a standout artist in today's music scene. “THEY DON’T KNOW” is available to buy/stream now on all platforms: https://lnk.site/theydontknow.
